source.stem: Which statement about the properties and uses of copper is correct?

options.text: It is used in electrical wiring, and it is ductile.
It is mixed with tin to make the alloy brass.
It is used in overhead electrical cables because it has a low density.
It is used in takeaway food containers because of its resistance to corrosion.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: It is safe to watch the solar eclipse by looking at the Sun's reflection in a hand mirror.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Looking directly at the eclipse is unsafe even through proper solar-eclipse viewing glasses.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Watching the Sun's projected image on a classroom screen without eclipse glasses is unsafe.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: When only a thin crescent of the Sun remains, it is safe to look directly without protection.

intelligence.enrichment: Even during a solar eclipse, the Sun can harm the eyes if viewed directly without proper protection, so solar eclipse viewing must use safe observing methods. Remaining sunlight from the Sun can damage the eyes, so direct unprotected viewing must be replaced by protected or projected viewing. The learner correctly applies this rule: Even during a solar eclipse, the Sun can harm the eyes if viewed directly without proper protection, so solar eclipse viewing must use safe observing methods. The Sun is safe to look at when the Moon covers part of it during an eclipse.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky. The student must decide: It is unsafe to look directly at the Sun during a solar eclipse without proper protection. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
